mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.session.selectSession */ SESSION_ID as sessionId, NAME as name, USING_DEPT as usingDept, START_TIME as startTime, INVITE_LINK as inviteLink, LINK_EXPIRY as linkExpiry, CREATED_BY as createdBy FROM SESSION WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.session.selectListSession */ SESSION_ID as sessionId, NAME as name, USING_DEPT as usingDept, START_TIME as startTime, INVITE_LINK as inviteLink, LINK_EXPIRY as linkExpiry, CREATED_BY as createdBy FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM SESSION WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.session.selectListCountSession */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM SESSION WHERE 1=1
